claims.head: Bodies will fly

claims.head: Watch for Aspirot, Lohrei against Dvorak, Konecny, Michkov
claims.body: At home, Boston’s P3 (Aspirot, Lohrei) has spent 42% of its 5-on-5 time against opponents’ second lines. With no line matching it would be about 27%. Tonight Philadelphia’s usual second line is Dvorak, Konecny, Michkov.
